offers_products.reason: Main offering is hospital and behavioral care delivery; software and consulting are minor side lines.

offers_services.reason: Operates acute care hospitals, behavioral health facilities, emergency departments, and Talkspace telehealth providing patient care.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Patients and families receive care at its hospitals, behavioral facilities and urgent care centers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Patients are the buyers; payers like insurers and Medicare pay, but organizations are not the main buyers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes from individual patient admissions and visits, not subscriptions or contracts, though demand is steady.

cyclical_demand.reason: Hospital and behavioral health care is medical need, not easily postponed in a recession.

big_ticket.reason: Typical hospital stay or visit is a routine healthcare episode, usually paid mostly by insurers.

people_delivered.reason: Care depends on staff but also on hospitals, beds and facilities; asset-based facility operator.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are individual patients, although government programs pay for much of the care.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns and operates hundreds of hospitals and behavioral facilities, requiring ongoing construction and capital investment.

notes: Payers are mainly insurers and government, so the organization-buyer and large-customer answers are borderline.
